rows.notes: 7.149 ms/token is the reciprocal of the measured 139.86 tokens/s median. The paired 1.371x statistic is the median of per-round ratios and need not equal the ratio of independent medians.

rows.label: Quiet-machine upper-bound projection

projection.method: Mechanically apply the ORCA paired ratio to the historical same-machine quiet 8.9 ms/token result.
assumptions: The relative ratio persists after ORCA ends, although CPU/GPU overlap is likely less valuable on a quiet CPU.
The prompt/context distribution remains comparable to the measured short fresh-prompt corpus.
This is explicitly an upper-bound projection, not a direct quiet-machine timing.

rows.notes: Upper-bound projection only. Do not present these values as measured.

publishedSubgroup32UnderOrca.notes: Paired six-round published subgroup-32 baseline under ORCA.

caveat: Absolute measured throughput was taken while ORCA saturated the CPU. The paired ratio is the robust headline; the quiet number is explicitly an upper-bound projection.
